title: The Mothman of Point Pleasant — Part 2 of 3

scenes.title: Thirteen months later, the bridge fell
scenes.narration: Thirteen months later, the bridge fell

scenes.text: Over the next 13 months, more than 100 people in the area reported seeing it. Fear settled over the river town.
scenes.narration: Over the next 13 months, more than 100 people in the area reported seeing it. Fear settled over the river town.

scenes.text: Then came December 15, 1967, evening rush hour. The Silver Bridge, linking Point Pleasant to Ohio, was busy with cars.
scenes.narration: Then came December 15, 1967, evening rush hour. The Silver Bridge, linking Point Pleasant to Ohio, was busy with cars.

scenes.text: The bridge fell into the river and 46 people died. Investigators traced it to a tiny crack in one steel link.
scenes.narration: The bridge fell into the river and 46 people died. Investigators traced it to a tiny crack in one steel link.

scenes.text: After the collapse the sightings largely stopped. Many locals came to see the creature as a warning.
